mapper.sql: select method_id, method_code, method_name, method_version, pharmacopoeia_ref, method_type, method_category, validation_status, validated_date, approved_by, status, effective_date, expiry_date, create_by, create_time from lims_test_method
mapper.insert: insert into lims_test_method( method_code, method_name, method_version, pharmacopoeia_ref, method_type, method_category, validation_status, validated_date, approved_by, status, effective_date, expiry_date, create_by, create_time )values( #{methodCode}, #{methodName}, #{methodVersion}, #{pharmacopoeiaRef}, #{methodType}, #{methodCategory}, #{validationStatus}, #{validatedDate}, #{approvedBy}, #{status}, #{effectiveDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
